Outsider (Archon, Good, Lawful) · SM +0 Hound Archon [Monster Manual, page 16]

A tall dog-headed warrior in plain gold-chased steel, carrying a greatsword in both hands. It smells a lie the way it smells a trail, sees through invisibility without effort, and hunts fiends with patient discipline — but will not raise the blade against anyone innocent, whatever the cost.

Aura of MenaceAn archon can activate this ability to cause all creatures within 10 yards of him to make a Fright Check. The archon can exclude any beings from the area of effect. If a victim succeeds at his Fright Check, he will be unaffected by the archon’s Aura of Menace for one hour. Use Awe check table from GURPS Powers, page 85, if possible.———
